name: Tiket per Kategori
query:
SELECT
	`tabNextHD Ticket`.category AS "Kategori:Link/NextHD Category:200",
	COUNT(`tabNextHD Ticket`.name) AS "Jumlah Tiket:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN `tabNextHD Ticket`.status = 'Selesai' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Jumlah Selesai:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN `tabNextHD Ticket`.status IN ('Baru', 'Sedang Dikerjakan', 'Menunggu User') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Jumlah Masih Terbuka:Int:150"
FROM
	`tabNextHD Ticket`
WHERE
	`tabNextHD Ticket`.creation >= %(from_date)s
	AND `tabNextHD Ticket`.creation <= %(to_date)s
	AND (%(ticket_type)s IS NULL OR `tabNextHD Ticket`.ticket_type = %(ticket_type)s)
GROUP BY
	`tabNextHD Ticket`.category
ORDER BY
	`tabNextHD Ticket`.category
